name: code-retrieval-stackoverflow-small
description: A small-scale code retrieval benchmark built from StackOverflow posts that measures a model's ability to retrieve relevant code snippets given a natural-language query. It evaluates retrieval quality in a real-world developer Q&A context where queries and candidate code come from actual StackOverflow threads. Primarily used to test retrieval models and rerankers in code search pipelines.
reputation: A niche, community-contributed benchmark used in code-retrieval research and smaller RAG experiments; modest adoption compared with larger, standard code-search datasets.
